findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is already effective, so a prospectus supplement or an ATM sales agreement can be filed and priced overnight with no further SEC action. This is a capability, not a dated event, which is why it is sized small.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has filed no takedown under this shelf. The earlier 2026-04-28 S-3 (effective 05-04, 424B3) was not a primary raise. No own-history reaction to an offering is available.
findings.why_not_priced: A filed takedown would show as an overnight gap down and a 424B5 on EDGAR. At $3.41, down 61% in 60 days, a raise is less attractive to the issuer, so the probability tonight is low. The price may already hold some overhang fear, but it holds no dated supply.
